text_block_list.text:
Having finished my work, as I was 
considering going for a walk—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer~♪ Could it be that you're 
going for a walk now? Are you, are you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, in that case... Karen would be 
super happy if you could keep me company 
for a biiit♪
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#AfterSchoolKaren #CuteCafe #Pink 
#StrawberryMilk #Vibes"
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#CuteKarenChan #TakingABreakFromSelfies 
#OnADate #With #AFriend"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey, Trainer-san. Is Karen 
looking... cute today too~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ Ehehe, I'm so happy. Take loooots of 
photos for me, okay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#WayBackHome #Sunset #SepiaKaren" —And 
done!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, thank you so much for hanging 
out with me today, Karen's beloved 
onii-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ So many cute photos! Having someone 
else take photos really is fun—

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Found you at last! You, the horse girl 
over there!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
You're Curren Chan, right?! Ugh... You're 
even cuter in person than on 
Umastagram...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah~! You follow me? Thank you so much☆ 
Since you're here, wanna take a photo 
together?

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?! —Wait, O-Of course not! I 
didn't come here to make friends!

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! I came to declare war. I might 
not be catching up yet, but one day, I'll 
definitely beat your Umalikes count!

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait. With the "mature charm" 
that you completely lack, I'll show you I 
can win!

Having said her piece, the woman hurried 
away while casting backward glances at 
Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...She left.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Mature... charm?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san. Do you think Karen... 
lacks "mature charm"?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Really? What parts of me are "mature"?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look straight at Karen, okay? I want you 
to tell me without looking away☆

It was true that Curren Chan was full of 
charm, but when asked about "mature 
charm," I couldn't put it into words 
well...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you hesitating? Because there's so 
much charm you can't pick just one? Fufu, 
in that case~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll have you help Karen find her 
quintessential "mature charm"♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Karen feels completely safe asking you, 
so... It's fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay~♪ Thank you, Onii-chan☆

And so, unable to refuse, I ended up 
helping Curren Chan search for her "mature 
charm"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That kind of felt like a dodge. Do 
you really think so~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, see, I knew it~! Geez, in that case, 
Karen will find her "mature charm" and 
show it off to you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And when your heart skips a beat~... Maybe 
you'll have to give me a present♪

Saying so, Curren Chan peeked up into my 
face with a mischievous smile.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... I see. Well, Karen's best years 
are still ahead of her!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You might not see it now, but when Karen 
grows up, I bet Trainer-san is gonna be so 
startled~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When that happens~... make sure you 
properly tell me that Karen made your 
heart race, okay?

Saying so, Curren Chan gave a playful, 
devilish little wink.
